## What was resolved

The seed carried two historical "as-drawn opening unbuilt" records on the 2f northern corridor junction (L029g3 span 9.904–10.929 m, L030g2 span 10.122–11.125 m along wall `wall_bc264d…`, reason `opening_crosses_room_boundaries`).

**Original-image evidence (2f_view.png):**
- Zoomed inspection + pixel profiles of the complete junction showed **exactly one door symbol**: a gap in the corridor north wall ink from the c002/c006 party-wall line (x≈699 px) to resumed ink (x=741 px, `profile_002`), one cyan leaf hinged west with a single quarter-circle arc swinging **north into room 2f-c006**.
- The party wall is continuously drawn (x=699–700, y 352–504, `profile_008`) → **no** c002↔c006 door; the c006-south/c011-north wall stretch east of the junction has no second symbol.
- Conclusion: the two old records describe **one physical door**; L030g2 was a shifted duplicate whose east end overshot the wall end (11.245 > 11.060) into the c011 corner — that is what broke compilation.

**Measured and applied (by claims, not literals):** jamb ink peaks bound to `profile_002` C01/C02, converted via `map_pixels` with anchors taken from the drawing's own observed wall planes (party-wall centreline 699.5 px↔9.9405 m; corridor wall line 525 px↔16.0646 m; c011 south line 614 px↔13.9982 m; and after the first overlay flagged a 5.8 % cross-axis scale disagreement, a third anchor: c006 east-wall inner face 918 px↔14.8784 m, `profile_010`). Final: **door `2f-door-c000-c006-junction`, 2f-c000 ↔ 2f-c006, host plane y=16.0646, jambs x 9.9518–10.8784 m** (claim_0004, adopted and applied; overlay confirms it projects onto the drawn jamb gap). The obsolete "unbuilt observations" unresolved note was replaced twice explicitly, ending with the refined span; both unbuilt records were resolved to the new door via `resolve_unbuilt_observation`. A **partial** opening review (`review_001`, 2f/doors) matches the corrected connection; all other 2f/1f doors remain explicitly unreviewed.
